## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (98%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 surgical frozen section with a single-class conformal set [F1] and tumor suggested at all four margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 98%, InSitu 2%, others 0% | Strong invasive carcinoma probability |
| Conformal set | Invasive (90% dataset coverage) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100th percentile OOD [F6] | Passes QC despite extreme OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (58%–69% similarity) [F5] | All nearest neighbors match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 3, 5, 10) · ↑ invasive · Strongest embedding score (+1.87 contribution) toward invasive carcinoma [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 4, 9) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable score (+1.04 contribution) failing AI spot checks (0/20) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Scarce benign stroma (-0.45 score, +0.63 contribution) favors invasion [F4] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Low tubule score (-0.55, +0.59 contribution), though caption-inconsistent · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (95% CI 0.002 to 0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven classifier faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0); leans on unreliable Frequent mitotic figures (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 JPEG degradation on this simulated frozen section (100th-percentile OOD) mimics invasion over in situ disease (contrast similarity 56%).
- Small validation cohort (n=132, 5% ECE) or moderate frozen-section error ranking (70% AUROC) overstates confidence or margin calls.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 5, 10**: Confirm true stromal invasion rather than frozen-section or JPEG compression artifact.
2. **Regions 1, 4, 7, 9**: Verify true mitoses (unreliable score) and check whether atypia stays duct-confined.
3. **Regions 0–4, 7–11**: Inspect all four outer margins (108–538 um involved) to confirm tumor at ink.
